_comment: Card ownership, granted by the controller. launch_gate reads launch_block_granted
and note; a false grant with no note reads as a stub, not as a decision.
Idle is not free: a card's owner is the job still running or the one the controller
has queued, never the instantaneous nvidia-smi row. Three collisions on 2026-09-01
came from reading an idle card as an available one.
note: Refused on purpose, not unanswered. The block is not granted because the launch is not ready: code_py_starcoder holds 3 files against a projected 8.85B tokens, all nine domains carry epochs marked ESTIMATED rather than derived from a token cache, and no domain carries a stamp the corpora gate can compare. Granting seven cards now idles them behind a NO-GO. Lifted when corpora and epochs_measured both read GO.
verified: 2026-09-01 20:30 by nvidia-smi on the pod: cards 1-7 at 0 MiB, card 0 at 5795 MiB

next_grant.note: no 6-card substitute for the memory question: the DDP bucket grows with world, so a 6-card peak cannot answer whether b32 fits at 7. That question is now answered (69.63 GiB at world=7, runs/w7_b32a1.log); the block is held for the corpus, not the memory.
